base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1.frequency, AVG(T1.amount) AS avg_amount
FROM account_loan AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.status = 'A'
GROUP BY T1.frequency
